targeting.source: GOB 259 CastWhenUsed 3 requires an interlock opponent with Dazed (state mask 2). This move uses that fight's ordinary hit contest.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler admits the queued special through the active NPC or player fight and its matching view/spawn handle. The Dazed predicate is checked before cost and reuse. The round retains the bound opponent.
targeting.test: MartialKungFuAdmissionMode sends the stock PR555 request outside combat and against an empty, stale or other live handle. All refuse before IS loss or a timer. It checks the missing Dazed refusal and queues the same move on the actual opponent once the state is active. The valid request resolves in a normal round, and the stock client received the landed move in PR555. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/555
